description: This source file defines the MessagesPanel class, which is a Swing UI component for displaying and interacting with debug messages in a panel within a GUI application. It manages message display, font configuration, and includes buttons for pausing and clearing messages.

classes.name: MessagesPanel
classes.description: A Swing panel component that displays debug messages with controls for pausing, clearing, and font customization.

methods.name: MessagesPanel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the message display panel with optional extra button.

methods.name: setPaused
methods.description: Sets the paused state for message updates and updates the pause button label.

methods.name: getButtonPanel
methods.description: Returns the JPanel containing control buttons.

methods.name: getMessagesScroll
methods.description: Returns the JScrollPane containing the message view.

methods.name: getFont
methods.description: Returns the current font used in the message display.

methods.name: setFont
methods.description: Sets the font for message display and updates the configuration node.

methods.name: loadFont
methods.description: Loads font settings from configuration node and applies them.
